Al\'s Desk Sync — my WhatsApp replies
Reads only your own sent messages in WhatsApp chats you\'ve switched on.

When you have a WhatsApp chat open that you\'ve switched on in Al\'s Desk Sync, this reads only YOUR outgoing messages so your desk knows you\'ve replied. It ignores every other app and every other chat, never reads incoming messages this way, and never types, taps or sends anything. Turn it off any time here or in the app.
